sentences.en: At the end of March, New York Magazine published a story with the title,
sentences.zh: 三月底，《纽约杂志》发表了一篇报道，题目是：

sentences.en: Is My Chest Tightness Anxiety or the Coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 我的胸闷是焦虑还是冠状病毒？

sentences.en: The author was concerned because for days, she'd felt tightness in her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 作者感到担忧，因为接连几天，她都觉得胸口发紧。

sentences.en: That can be a symptom of COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 那可能是新冠肺炎的一个症状。

sentences.en: But it's also a symptom of anxiety.
In the last couple of months, many of us have become familiar with the feeling of fear
sentences.zh: 在过去几个月里，我们许多人都开始熟悉恐惧感

sentences.en: We may feel restless, physically exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会感到烦躁、身体疲惫。

sentences.en: At times, we may even have trouble catching our breath.
sentences.zh: 有时，我们甚至会感到呼吸困难。

sentences.en: This deep connection between mind and body made us think about an episode we did a while
sentences.zh: 这种身心之间的紧密联系让我们想起了不久前做过的一期节目，

sentences.en: back about a dimension of medicine that few of us recognize.
sentences.zh: 关于我们鲜少意识到的医学维度。

sentences.en: And we thought we'd bring it back today as a reminder of how our minds are tied to our
sentences.zh: 我们觉得今天可以重播这期节目，提醒大家我们的内心是如何与

sentences.en: physical suffering and the complex ways in which healing unfolds.
sentences.zh: 身体痛苦相连的，以及康复过程的复杂方式。

sentences.en: When you're eight years old, it's not easy to say goodbye to your dad for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 当你八岁时，要跟爸爸道别整整一年可不容易。

sentences.en: But that's what Andrew Marvin had to do.
sentences.zh: 但安德鲁·马尔文就不得不这么做。

sentences.en: His dad was a commander in the Navy and was deployed to Bahrain.
sentences.zh: 他的爸爸是一名海军指挥官，被派驻到巴林。

sentences.en: While his dad was away, something happened to Andrew.
sentences.zh: 在爸爸不在期间，安德鲁身上发生了一些变化。

sentences.en: Every time my husband's name was brought up, he would develop a headache.
sentences.zh: 每当我丈夫的名字被提起，他就会头痛。

sentences.en: This is Andrew's mom, Anne-Marie Marvin.
sentences.zh: 这是安德鲁的妈妈，安妮-玛丽·马尔文。

sentences.en: She knew her son's pain was real.
sentences.zh: 她知道儿子的痛苦是真实的。

sentences.en: She didn't want him to suffer.
As she tried to figure out how to help, she remembered an episode of the TV show MASH.
sentences.zh: 当她试图找出帮助他的方法时，她想起了电视剧《陆军流动医院》的一集。

sentences.en: The series is set in a fictionalized army hospital.
sentences.zh: 这部剧的背景是一个虚构的军队医院。

sentences.en: Let's go back to the tent.
The doctors had a problem on their hands.
sentences.zh: 医生们手头遇到了一个难题。

sentences.en: The hospital was full of wounded soldiers but was out of painkillers.
sentences.zh: 医院里挤满了受伤的士兵，却没有止痛药了。

sentences.en: A colonel suggested an unusual solution.
sentences.zh: 一位上校提出了一个不同寻常的解决方案。

sentences.en: Treat the patients with a placebo.
If we believe it, they're only taking sugar pills.
sentences.zh: 如果我们相信的话，他们吃的只是糖丸。

sentences.en: The doctors gave out the placebos while pretending they were real pills.
sentences.zh: 医生们分发了安慰剂，同时假装它们是真药。

sentences.en: You're really beginning to feel it, aren't you, son?
sentences.zh: 你真的开始有感觉了，对吧，孩子？

sentences.en: It's going to feel even better now.
The lesson Anne-Marie took away from the scene was, make the placebo treatment look real.
sentences.zh: 安妮-玛丽从那个场景中得到的教训是，要把安慰剂治疗做得逼真。

sentences.en: So I went to the store and I got a bottle of Motrin and I got a bottle of chewable vitamin C tablets
sentences.zh: 所以我去了商店，买了一瓶美林，又买了一瓶可咀嚼的维生素C片，
然后我把两瓶药调换了。

sentences.en: As Anne-Marie gave Andrew the vitamins, she made sure the lie didn't look like a lie.
sentences.zh: 当安妮-玛丽给安德鲁维生素时，她确保这个谎言看起来不像谎言。

sentences.en: I would emphasize that he had to really have a headache.
sentences.zh: 我会强调他必须真的是头痛。

sentences.en: I would treat it as I would a regular drug that I wouldn't want to medicate unless absolutely necessary.
sentences.zh: 我会像对待常规药物那样对待它，除非万不得已，否则我不想给他用药。

sentences.en: On a couple rare occasions, he said it didn't work and asked for a second pill.
sentences.zh: 有几次罕见的情况，他说没用，要求吃第二粒药。

sentences.en: I would make him wait 20 minutes to see if it would work first as I would a regular medication before I let him take a second one.
sentences.zh: 我会让他等20分钟看看是否起效，就像对待常规药物那样，然后才让他吃第二粒。

sentences.en: I emphasized that I couldn't do any more than that because of the dose.
sentences.zh: 我强调过由于剂量的原因我不能再多给。

sentences.en: Every single time we used the placebo, the headache went away, usually within about a half an hour.
sentences.zh: 每一次我们使用安慰剂，头痛都会消失，通常在大约半小时内。

sentences.en: Anne-Marie's small act of parental deception raises lots of questions.
sentences.zh: 安妮-玛丽这种小小的父母欺骗行为引发了许多问题。

sentences.en: If you can make a child's headaches disappear with a vitamin, what else can you do with a placebo?
sentences.zh: 如果你能用维生素让孩子的头痛消失，你还能用安慰剂做什么？

sentences.en: What was happening in Andrew's mind and body as he took the pills?
sentences.zh: 当安德鲁吃药时，他的大脑和身体里发生了什么？

sentences.en: How much was the cure linked to the rituals that Anne-Marie built into the treatment?
sentences.zh: 治愈效果与安妮-玛丽在治疗中建立的仪式感有多大关系？

sentences.en: Perhaps most difficult of all, can you get the same results without deception?
sentences.zh: 或许最难的问题是，不靠欺骗能达到同样的效果吗？

sentences.en: These are not questions doctors generally ask.
sentences.zh: 这些通常不是医生会问的问题。

sentences.en: For centuries, scientists have used placebos mainly to deflate the claims of con men
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，科学家使用安慰剂主要是为了驳斥骗子的说法，

sentences.en: and to test the efficacy of drugs and medical interventions.
sentences.zh: 并测试药物和医疗干预的疗效。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, what it means to be sick and what it means to heal
sentences.zh: 本周的“隐藏的大脑”，探讨生病的意义和治愈的意义，

sentences.en: and the powerful tool that modern medicine has overlooked.
sentences.zh: 以及现代医学一直忽视的强大工具。

sentences.en: 1996 was quite the year for men's basketball.
sentences.zh: 1996年对男子篮球来说是相当了不起的一年。

sentences.en: It's the year that Space Jam, starring Michael Jordan and Charles Barkley, made it to theaters.
sentences.zh: 那是迈克尔·乔丹和查尔斯·巴克利主演的《空中大灌篮》上映的年份。

sentences.en: Here's your chance, do your dance at the Space Jam.
sentences.zh: 这是你的机会，在空中大灌篮里跳你的舞。

sentences.en: It was also the year of Dream Team 3.
sentences.zh: 这也是梦三队诞生的一年。

sentences.en: That was the nickname given to the 1996 U.S.

sentences.zh: 男子奥运篮球队的绰号。

sentences.en: They dominated the court in Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 他们在亚特兰大的球场上称霸。

sentences.en: Is that the year we won the gold?
sentences.zh: 那是我们赢得金牌的那一年吗？

sentences.en: We win the gold every year.
And they are headed to the gold medal.
If you look closely at old videos of those games, you can see him sitting near the sidelines,
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看那些比赛的旧录像，你可以看到他坐在场边附近，

sentences.en: wearing a sport jacket and tie.
sentences.zh: 穿着运动夹克系着领带。

sentences.en: He was one of the physicians for the team.
You might recognize some of the players Bruce has treated.
sentences.zh: 你可能认出布鲁斯治疗过的一些球员。

sentences.en: Hakeem Olajuwon, Shaquille O'Neal, David Robinson, Charles Barkley, Carl Malone, John Stockton, Mitch Richmond.
sentences.zh: 哈基姆·奥拉朱旺、沙奎尔·奥尼尔、大卫·罗宾逊、查尔斯·巴克利、卡尔·马龙、约翰·斯托克顿、米奇·里奇蒙德。

sentences.en: For years, Bruce worked as an orthopedic surgeon for the Houston NBA team, the Rockets.
sentences.zh: 多年来，布鲁斯一直担任休斯顿NBA球队火箭队的骨科医生。

sentences.en: He performed lots of intricate surgeries.
sentences.zh: 他做过许多复杂的手术。

sentences.en: He loved seeing players glide across the court and soar in the air.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢看球员在球场上滑行并在空中翱翔。

sentences.en: In a way, that's my knee.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，那是我的膝盖。

sentences.en: Bruce's exceptional surgical skill is what makes it so surprising that he, of all people,
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯精湛的外科技术使他成为最不可能这样做的人，然而偏偏是他

sentences.en: would lead a study that questions the primacy of surgical skill.
sentences.zh: 领导了一项质疑外科技术至高无上地位的研究。

sentences.en: Did I ever see myself doing this?
sentences.zh: 我曾经想过自己会做这种事吗？

sentences.en: In 1989, years before he was a physician for the Rockets,
sentences.zh: 在1989年，远在他是火箭队队医之前，

sentences.en: Bruce started working at the Baylor College of Medicine in Houston.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯开始在休斯顿的贝勒医学院工作。

sentences.en: He became interested in a knee surgery that's meant to help people with arthritis.
sentences.zh: 他对一项旨在帮助关节炎患者的膝关节手术产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: It wasn't a common surgery where he received his medical training.
sentences.zh: 在他接受医学培训的地方，这不是一项常见的手术。

sentences.en: And then when I came here to Houston, it seemed like surgeons were doing it almost nonstop.
sentences.zh: 然后当我来到休斯顿这里时，似乎外科医生们几乎在马不停蹄地做这个手术。

sentences.en: He found it odd that surgeons in some parts of the country were doing the procedure far more often than others.
sentences.zh: 他发现奇怪的是，国内某些地区的外科医生做这种手术的频率远高于其他地区。

sentences.en: Patients reported feeling better after the surgery, but no one knew why.
sentences.zh: 患者报告说手术后感觉好多了，但没有人知道为什么。

sentences.en: Was it because surgeons scrape away bits of tissue from the joint?
sentences.zh: 是因为外科医生刮除了关节里的一小片组织吗？

sentences.en: Or could it simply be an effect of salt water?
sentences.zh: 或者它简而言之只是盐水的作用？

sentences.en: As part of the procedure, surgeons flushed the knee with saline solution.
sentences.zh: 作为手术的一部分，外科医生用盐水冲洗了膝盖。

sentences.en: Bruce wanted to run a trial to answer these questions.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯想进行一项试验来回答这些问题。

sentences.en: One set of patients would get the standard surgery.
sentences.zh: 一组患者将接受标准手术。

sentences.en: Another would just get their joint flushed with saline.
sentences.zh: 另一组只是用盐水冲洗他们的关节。

sentences.en: He went to a colleague to discuss his plan.
sentences.zh: 他去找一位同事讨论他的计划。

sentences.en: When I pitched it, she was the one that said,
sentences.zh: 当我提出这个想法时，正是她说道，

sentences.en: well, how do you know it's not all a placebo effect?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你怎么知道这不完全是安慰剂效应呢？

sentences.en: The same phenomenon that helped 8-year-old Andrew Marvin and the soldiers in MASH.
sentences.zh: 正是那个帮助了8岁安德鲁·马尔文和《陆军流动医院》中士兵的现象。

sentences.en: As a surgeon, I was like, this doesn't have anything to do with sugar pills and things like that.
sentences.zh: 作为一名外科医生，我当时觉得，这跟糖丸之类的事没有任何关系。

sentences.en: But Bruce's colleague explained to him that the placebo effect comes in many shapes and sizes.
sentences.zh: 但布鲁斯的同事向他解释说，安慰剂效应有多种形状和大小。

sentences.en: If it's a small pill, sometimes there's not as big a placebo effect as a bigger pill.
sentences.zh: 如果是一粒小药丸，有时安慰剂效应不如大一点的药丸那么大。

sentences.en: Or if they say it's a new and exciting pill, there's probably more of a placebo effect than a traditional pill.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他们说这是一粒新奇的药丸，安慰剂效应可能比传统药丸更大。

sentences.en: And many times an injection can have more of a placebo effect than a pill.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，注射的安慰剂效应可能比吃药更大。

sentences.en: And many times, you know, some other intervention can have more of a placebo effect than an injection.
sentences.zh: 而且很多时候，你知道，其他的一些干预措施的安慰剂效应可能比注射更大。

sentences.en: And perhaps surgery may have the biggest placebo effect of all.
sentences.zh: 也许手术可能拥有最大的安慰剂效应。

sentences.en: Surgeons like Bruce don't think about these questions very much.
sentences.zh: 像布鲁斯这样的外科医生不会过多地去思考这些问题。

sentences.en: Because the idea of comparing actual treatment to placebo treatment isn't built into the practice of surgery.
sentences.zh: 因为将实际治疗与安慰剂治疗进行比较的想法并没有内置到外科手术的实践中。

sentences.en: If you're trying to bring a new medication to the market, you have to go through all kinds of randomized trials,
sentences.zh: 如果你试图将一种新药推向市场，你必须经历各种随机试验，

sentences.en: including, you know, a placebo group, and prove that your product is superior to the placebo treatment group.
sentences.zh: 包括，你知道的，一个安慰剂组，并证明你的产品优于安慰剂治疗组。

sentences.en: Well, surgeries don't go through that same scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 然而，手术并没有经历同样的审查。

sentences.en: Surgeries are many times adopted because it's an improvement over a previous surgery,
sentences.zh: 手术往往被采用是因为它是对先前手术的改进，

sentences.en: which is an improvement on a previous surgery, which is an improvement on one before that.
sentences.zh: 而先前的手术又是对再之前手术的改进，那又是对之前手术的改进。

sentences.en: And long story short, very few surgeries ever go through randomized trials.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，极少有手术会经历随机试验。

sentences.en: And almost no surgeries have a placebo control group.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有任何手术设有安慰剂对照组。

sentences.en: Bruce and his team decided their study would have not two, but three groups.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯和他的团队决定他们的研究不设两个，而是三个组。

sentences.en: The first would get the real surgery.
sentences.zh: 第一组将接受真正的手术。

sentences.en: The second would have saline washed through the joint.
sentences.zh: 第二组将用盐水冲洗关节。

sentences.en: The third would be a placebo group.
Anyone who signed up was informed about the three possible kinds of treatment.
sentences.zh: 任何报名的人都会被告知三种可能的治疗方式。

sentences.en: We told them going in, you're going to get randomized to one of three groups, and these are the three groups.
sentences.zh: 我们在开始时告诉他们，你们将被随机分配到三个组之一，这就是这三个组。

sentences.en: And we actually had them sign a piece of paper that said,
sentences.zh: 我们实际上让他们签署了一张纸，上面写着，

sentences.en: I understand that I may be randomized to a control group that is a placebo group.
sentences.zh: 我理解我可能会被随机分配到一个作为安慰剂组的对照组。
安慰剂的意思就是假装。

sentences.en: And that if I'm in this group, I'll have a pretend surgery, not a real surgery.
sentences.zh: 如果我在这一组，我将接受假手术，而不是真的手术。

sentences.en: And they had to write it in their own handwriting
to make sure that they, you know, fully understood everything we were saying.
sentences.zh: 以确保他们，你知道，完全理解了我们所说的一切。

sentences.en: The researchers followed certain procedures to make sure all three types of surgeries felt real to everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 研究人员遵循了某些程序，以确保所有三种类型的手术对所有相关人员来说都感觉是真实的。

sentences.en: Real to the patients and their families, and as real as possible to the physicians.
sentences.zh: 对患者及其家属来说是真实的，对医生来说也尽可能真实。

sentences.en: Bruce would put on his scrubs and walk into the OR without knowing what type of surgery he was going to perform.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯会穿上手术服走进手术室，却不知道他将要做哪种类型的手术。

sentences.en: He found out only when he opened an envelope.
sentences.zh: 只有当他打开一个信封时他才会知道。

sentences.en: The patient would be wheeled into the room.
They'd be placed onto the table.
sentences.zh: 他们将被安置在手术台上。

sentences.en: And once they're on the table, we would open the randomization envelope,
sentences.zh: 一旦上了手术台，我们就会打开随机分配信封，

sentences.en: which would disclose which of the three groups that would be placed into.
sentences.zh: 其中会透露将被分到三个组中的哪一组。

sentences.en: All the patients were given general anesthesia.
sentences.zh: 所有患者都接受了全身麻醉。

sentences.en: All got incisions in their knees.
sentences.zh: 所有人的膝盖上都有切口。

sentences.en: Patients in the first two groups received surgery or got their knees flushed with saline.
sentences.zh: 前两组的患者接受了手术，或是用生理盐水冲洗了膝关节。

sentences.en: And then the third group, the placebo group, they would go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 然后是第三组，即安慰剂组，他们会去睡觉。

sentences.en: I'd make three little holes in the skin.
sentences.zh: 我会在皮肤上切三个小孔。

sentences.en: And then I wouldn't put any instruments actually inside the knee joint itself.
sentences.zh: 实际上我不会把任何器械放进膝关节里面。

sentences.en: Instead, Bruce fired up a video.
sentences.zh: 相反，布鲁斯播放了一段视频。

sentences.en: I had a videotape of a real arthroscopy they had done on a patient.
sentences.zh: 我有一段他们对患者做过的真实关节镜手术的录像。

sentences.en: And I would pop it in the VCR machine.
sentences.zh: 然后我会把它插进录像机里。

sentences.en: We would tape all of these surgeries during this time.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，我们会把所有这些手术都录下来。

sentences.en: And I would actually pretend like I was doing with the leg what I would normally do
sentences.zh: 我实际上会假装我在用腿做我通常会做的事情

sentences.en: if I was doing those different things during the real surgery.
sentences.zh: 如果我在真实手术中做那些不同的事情的话。

sentences.en: If I put something in the knee on the videotape,
sentences.zh: 如果我在录像里的膝盖里放了什么东西，

sentences.en: I would actually ask for that instrument and pretend like I was doing something.
sentences.zh: 我实际上会要求那个器械，并假装我在做什么。

sentences.en: We would ask and pass instruments like we were doing the real thing,
sentences.zh: 我们会像做真手术一样要求并传递器械，

sentences.en: even though we weren't doing any real surgery.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们没有做任何真正的手术。

sentences.en: Bruce took these additional measures because he wanted to account for situations
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯采取这些额外的措施是因为他想考虑到这样一种情况：

sentences.en: where a patient wasn't 100% out from the anesthesia.
sentences.zh: 患者并未完全从麻醉中醒过来。

sentences.en: The other thing about that videotape was it made certain that we spent the proper amount of time
sentences.zh: 关于那段录像的另一件事是，它确保了我们花了适当的时间

sentences.en: And for instance, we didn't want the placebo group where we didn't really do anything
sentences.zh: 举个例子，我们不希望我们其实什么都没做的安慰剂组

sentences.en: to be much shorter than the other types of surgeries.
sentences.zh: 比其他类型的手术时间短得多。

sentences.en: So that if I went and talked to the nurses in the recovery room or the patient's family afterwards,
sentences.zh: 这样一来，如果我随后去和恢复室的护士或患者家属谈话，

sentences.en: they could look at their watch and say, oh, that was only 10 minutes, so it must have been a placebo.
sentences.zh: 他们可以看看手表说，哦，那才10分钟，所以肯定是个安慰剂。

sentences.en: So we spent the same amount of time with the placebo group pretending to do surgery
sentences.zh: 因此，我们花在安慰剂组身上的、假装做手术的时间

sentences.en: as if we had done the real surgery in the other groups.
sentences.zh: 和我们在其他组中做真实手术的时间一样长。
